title: Event attendance
passage: How many people signed up for the tour? A. Just over thirty so far. B. We leave from the lobby. C. Sign your name at the bottom.
passageZh:
有多少人報名參觀？
A. 目前稍微超過三十人。
B. 我們從大廳出發。
C. 在底部簽上名字。
